description:
**What:** Change PrincipalFilterCondition.type_ field from Option<String> to Option<PrincipalType> in crate-jmap-sharing-types/src/principal.rs.

**Algorithm:**
1. In principal.rs, change the field declaration from Option<String> to Option<PrincipalType>.
2. The #[serde(rename = "type")] attribute stays unchanged.
3. Update the existing filter_condition_roundtrip test: change the assertion from .as_deref() == Some("individual") to == Some(PrincipalType::Individual).
4. Add test filter_condition_type_other_roundtrip: deserialize {"type": "future-unknown-value"} → assert Some(PrincipalType::Other("future-unknown-value".to_owned())), then serialize back and assert round-trip produces same JSON.
5. Run cargo test -p jmap-sharing-types.

**Defensive programming rules:**
- No unwrap in library code.
- All test assertions use named error messages.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- cargo test -p jmap-sharing-types exits 0.
- PrincipalFilterCondition { type_: Some(PrincipalType::Individual), ..Default::default() } serializes to {"type":"individual"}.
- Deserializing {"type":"future-val"} gives Some(PrincipalType::Other("future-val".to_owned())).
- cargo clippy -p jmap-sharing-types -- -D warnings exits 0.
title: Fix PrincipalFilterCondition.type_ to use PrincipalType enum
